scope: the skills repo arms its OWN .githooks/pre-push on npm install (prepare -> install-hooks) and runs its own fast offline gates locally; ADR-0053.

boundary.evidence: a local pre-flight loop; no business rule.

ownership.evidence: gate commands are the repo npm scripts (single source); the hook does not duplicate them.

dependency.evidence: CommonJS require, parses on Node 20 and 24; shell:true with a trusted const (no injection).

error-handling.evidence: FOUND+FIXED (HIGH): check:verbatim needs the gitignored vendor/cheatsheets-src/ (network-fetched via vendor:owasp), so on a FRESH CLONE it fails closed (exit 2) and the hook blocked EVERY push, contradicting the offline premise and training --no-verify. The author verified on a primed machine so missed it. Removed check:verbatim from GATES (stays CI owasp-verbatim which vendors first); re-verified by running the hook with the vendor dir MOVED ASIDE -> exit 0. install-hooks swallows all errors + exits 0 so prepare never breaks npm ci.

findings.title: check:verbatim in the pre-push blocks every push on a fresh clone (gitignored, network-vendored prerequisite)
findings.question: error-handling
findings.evidence: vendor/cheatsheets-src/ is gitignored with 0 tracked files, populated only by npm run vendor:owasp; check-verbatim.mjs die(2) on ENOENT. Removed from GATES; ADR/docstring corrected; re-verified hook exits 0 with vendor dir absent.

grepCommands: ran .githooks/pre-push with vendor/cheatsheets-src MOVED ASIDE -> exit 0 (observed, the fresh-clone proof)
check:architecture exit0; check:links exit0; receipt complete+diff-bound; routing 0 rules (observed)
reviewer confirmed CJS parses Node20/24, shell:true no injection, prepare never fails npm ci, tests discriminating (observed)
verdict: PASS after fix: review caught 1 HIGH (check:verbatim would false-block every fresh-clone push via a gitignored network-vendored prerequisite); removed it from the local gate list, corrected the ADR/docstring, and re-verified the hook passes with the vendored source absent. Other 5 checks (CJS parse, shell injection, receipt-no-args, prepare-never-fails-CI, test discrimination) all cleared.
